title: JustinGuitar Grade 1 Practice Routine – Consolidation and Song‑Focused Plan
summary: This video outlines a practical, editable practice routine aimed at consolidating Grade 1 skills. It emphasizes targeted chord-change drills for the weakest pairs, two minutes of 4/4 strumming with a metronome, deliberate work in 6/8 time, riffs for fun, and a strong emphasis on playing songs. The host also recommends a potential finger-stretching exercise, tuning practice as needed, a self‑test after a period of study, and a philosophy that prioritizes solid foundations and enjoyment of the learning journey over rushing to the next grade.
